scope: One isolated classic-overlay2 Linux arm64 Docker engine on the same physical host. Existing reconciled two-fleet generation, scoped HTTPS, D1/R2/Durable Object fixture and internal candidate enrollment. Ordinary candidate admission remains closed.
limitations: This restarts the gateway process inside an already reconciled installation generation; it does not authorize a full installation or restored-generation startup.
Backing storage and native replica availability remain dependencies. This is not whole-stack high availability or a performance measurement.
